pages.title: Game Dev Agent Landing Page
pages.description: An AI agent for game studios whose hero is a playable three.js diorama: a toy biplane with a corgi pilot flying a low-poly cherry-blossom road under bloom and tilt-shift, a full-page loader, a crew picker that repaints the plane live, in-engine card stills and generated sound
bestFor: game studios and game dev tooling

pages.title: Maasai-Inspired Event Landing Page
pages.description: A cultural events studio page on Maasai-inspired dusk: a Rive hero rebuilt in SVG where four warriors leap into the adumu, a scroll-driven frieze of leaping silhouettes, generated beadwork and gala art, and textures cut from the warriors' own shapes

credits.label: Maasai-Inspired Event Hero Banner Concept — Rive Marketplace
credits.note: The Rive file whose hero this page recreates in plain SVG and CSS, with no Rive runtime

pages.title: AI Work Assistant Chat Landing Page
pages.description: A soft pastel AI-assistant launch page whose hero is a working chat: it types its own first question, streams answers with thread cards, drafts and calendar slots, and is ringed by agent badges that spin, tick and fail on their own

pages.title: Peptide Skincare Store Landing Page
pages.description: A warm, cream-toned peptide skincare store whose hero is a spinning sphere of code-drawn product tiles behind a glass search bar that types its own queries, with springy lab-style product renders, a draggable Dose lab vial, bubble-popping add-to-bag and a day-to-night routine

pages.title: Blackletter Biology Workbench
pages.description: A computational biology platform set like an illuminated manuscript: blackletter headings lit by a WebGL shader, spinning conic frame borders, and hand-drawn lab sketches in the margins
bestFor: brands with a literary or archival voice

credits.label: Rough.js by Preet Shihn
credits.note: The hand-drawn rendering library behind the margin sketches (MIT)

pages.title: LED Metro Tech Storefront
pages.description: A big-tech devices homepage in warm clay and glass, with a live LED metro map for a hero, a Personal/Business switch that rewrites the page, and a dot-matrix ticker
bestFor: software suites with personal and business audiences

credits.label: CSS LED Challenge by Ben Evans (ivorjetski) on CodePen
credits.note: The LED dot-matrix style the metro maps are adapted from

pages.title: Hazard Terminal Security Page
pages.description: Antivirus as an amber hazard terminal: a spinning seal HUD, a live scan where three cores vote, and a searchable grid of 72 spirits, each guarding a threat
bestFor: developer tools with a strong theme
games and occult or horror brands

pages.title: Retro Messenger Agent Page
pages.description: An AI agent pitched as your old instant-messenger buddy: a working chat window that plans and runs tasks, nudges that shake the screen, and a buddy-list footer
bestFor: AI agents with a friendly face

pages.title: Event Horizon Orbital Page
pages.description: Satellite servicing under a ray-marched black hole you can drag to orbit, with nine live three.js mission scenes inside amber glass cards
bestFor: technical services with a showcase hero
products that want a WebGL wow moment

pages.title: Faceted Iceberg Platform Page
pages.description: An AI agent platform drawn in low-poly crystal: a shape-mosaic hero, an iceberg whose waterline drops as the platform takes on the stack, and a faceted sunrise footer
bestFor: developer platforms with a pricing page
B2B SaaS that needs a stack diagram

pages.title: Card Scanner Finance Page
pages.description: Autonomous finance agents: tilted cards in an orbit ring, a scroll-pinned scanner that turns cards into code, and a live control bento
bestFor: B2B SaaS with a live product story

credits.label: Made by Beings
credits.note: The page's design and build, as credited in its footer.

credits.label: Card scanner inspired by evervault
credits.note: The scroll-driven scanner that turns cards into code follows the effect on evervault's site.

pages.title: Paper Sun Agent Page
pages.description: AI agents for the night shift: a paper-cut sunset panel you can slap stickers on, a dusk-to-daybreak arc, and a run log that stops to ask

pages.title: Tide Reveal Agent Page
pages.description: An AI agent platform over a live WebGL sea that, on scroll, ebbs into a terminal window, then a clickable workspace and a run trace
bestFor: B2B SaaS with a product demo

pages.title: Manga Panel Dev Tool Page
pages.description: A deploy CLI pitched as a black-and-white manga issue: a sliced retro sun over a city skyline, a typing terminal, three villains defeated and a reader-mail FAQ

pages.title: Ghost Agent Landing Page
pages.description: Invisible AI agents pitched as ghosts: pixel ghosts float up a curved hero, and three SVG ghosts clear a 100-task board live

pages.title: Sunset Scroll Story Page
pages.description: A fusion company told as one long sunset: scroll and the sun goes down over a layered SVG landscape, night falls, then a live canvas tokamak takes over

credits.label: Parallax scroll landscape by isladjan
credits.note: The layered SVG landscape and its sunset-to-night scroll choreography come from this piece.

pages.title: Radiating Rings Hero Page
pages.description: Concentric stadium rings radiating out of the call to action, under a streaked orb, with glass readouts floating in the gaps

pages.title: Highlighter Markup Page

credits.label: Nice <mark> by Christian Alder
credits.note: The highlighter treatment - the displaced ::before, the pen blob and the --color hook - comes from this pen.

pages.title: Recessed Aperture Hero Page

pages.title: Stage Light Launch Page
